en.context: Telegram exchange. Operator and Goblin speakers are labelled. Assistant suggestions are not operator decisions.
en.text:
Operator: the podcast rss fetch keeps timing out on sundays, anything we can do
Goblin: it's the host rate-limiting us — sitemap says they batch-publish sunday 6am and the feed regenerates slowly. I can move the check to sunday 14:00 with a 3-stagger retry.
Operator: do that. also note that I hate when the summary email arrives before the episodes are even processed
Goblin: noted: summaries only after ingest completes. Moving the cron to 14:00 America/Mexico_City with backoff.
